phases.state: TurtleBot3_1 is at the responder base, ready to start its mission to search for survivors in the west sector and west room of a partially collapsed building.
phases.phase_target: Navigate through the rubble corridor to the hub at the south end.

phases.state: TurtleBot3_1 has reached the hub and is preparing for the west sector inspection. Its position is (-2.3, 0.5).
phases.phase_target: Perform a scan of the west sector inspection point and detect survivors.

phases.state: TurtleBot3_1 has finished the west sector inspection and is equipped with LiDAR and a camera for the next phase.
phases.phase_target: Navigate to the west doorway of the fallen wall and enter the west room.

phases.state: TurtleBot3_1 has arrived at the west room and is about to start the survivor search. Its location is (-3.0, -0.55).
phases.phase_target: Conduct a detailed scan of the west room inspection point and confirm the survivor.

phases.state: TurtleBot3_1 has successfully located and confirmed the survivor in the west room and is at the inspection point.
phases.phase_target: Report the mission status to the APM and wait for further instructions or the rescue team.

phases.state: TurtleBot3_2 is deployed at the responder base, ready to assist in the search and rescue mission. The robot is positioned at coordinates (-1.2, 1.95) and is tasked with locating and assisting survivors in the east sector.
phases.phase_target: Navigate to the east sector inspection point and perform a thorough scan.

phases.state: Having completed the east sector inspection, TurtleBot3_2 now proceeds to the east room, located at the east doorway point (-1.4, 0.5).
phases.phase_target: Enter the east room and navigate to the inspection point (-1.4, -0.55) for a detailed scan and survivor detection.

phases.state: After the east room inspection, TurtleBot3_2 is returning to the hub at (-2.3, 0.5).
phases.phase_target: Guide the rescue team by navigating back to the hub and then north through the rubble corridor to the base at (-2.3, 1.95).

phases.state: TurtleBot3_2 has completed its tasks, inspecting the east sector and east room, and is now at the base.
phases.phase_target: Communicate mission completion to the APM with a summary of findings and locations.
